changeSet.author: mgoodrich
changeSet.comment: HAI-1235: Central's Dossier Number auto-generation options for UHM, CDI, and Cange are moving from being created ad hoc by ConfigureHaitiIdGenerators.java (with a randomly assigned uuid) to being managed by Initializer's autogenerationoptions domain (see configuration/backend_configuration/autogenerationoptions/autogenerationoptions-site-central.csv). This repoints each existing row's uuid to the uuid that CSV expects, so Initializer updates the existing row in place instead of creating a duplicate for the same identifier type/location pair. This runs before Initializer loads (see ConfigurationSetup.configureDependencies() in pihcore). It is a safe no-op on any server that does not have these locations, since the location/identifier type subqueries simply match zero rows there.
